description: Text-to-3D reference-image eval set for scripts/grok-eval-ref-image.mjs. Each prompt is sent through api/_lib/forge-reference-image.js exactly as the forge sends a user prompt, then reconstructed by the self-hosted TRELLIS lane and rendered by /api/render/glb. The hard category holds thin structures and transparent objects, the two shapes image-to-3D handles worst.
